name: ContextMenu
description: The menu that opens at the pointer on a right click, a long press or the keyboard (Shift+F10 or the Menu key) over an area such as a file row. It never replaces a visible way to do the same thing.

label.description: Accessible name of the menu, e.g. "Actions for report.pdf".

children.description: The area the menu belongs to, such as a row or a card. It becomes focusable.

hint.description: Text read by screen readers when the area is focused. It is not shown on screen.

onAction.description: Called with the id of the item chosen.

selectionMode.description: none for actions; single or multiple makes every item checkable.

selectedKeys.description: Controlled selected items when selectionMode is not none.

onSelectionChange.description: Called when the checked items change.

isDisabled.description: Turns the menu off. The area stays as it is and the browser's own menu returns.

elementType.description: The element the area renders as, so a table row stays a row.

keyboard: Shift+F10 or the Menu key on the focused area opens the menu next to it
Up and Down Arrow move between items, wrapping at the ends; Home and End jump to the first and last
Typing a letter moves to the next item starting with it
Enter or Space chooses the item and closes the menu (in a checkable menu, toggles it)
Esc closes the menu and returns focus to the area
requirements: A context menu is never the only way to do something: every action must also exist as a visible control
The area is focusable (tabIndex 0) and described by a hint, so keyboard and screen reader users learn the menu is there
Opens on right click, on a touch long press, and from the keyboard
Focus returns to the area when the menu closes
Destructive items say what they do in their text, not only in red
screenReader: Focusing the area reads its content followed by "Press Shift+F10 for actions"
Opening announces a menu named by its label and its first item, with its position

use_when: Shortcuts to actions that already have a visible button or menu, on rows, cards or files
Dense lists where every row cannot carry a row of buttons
avoid_when: The action has no other way to be reached: add a button or a Menu
An action list on a button: use Menu
Text fields: leave the browser's own menu (copy, paste)
anti_patterns: A context menu as the only place for an action
Disabling the browser menu over a whole page
Nesting a context menu inside another
